critical_code_review_comments: decision_dna.compose_dna: liquidity_score uses (spread_mult(spread,symbol)-0.55)/0.45*100 — negative or >100 values are possible when spread is far outside expected band; consider clamping to [0,100] to match documented axis semantics.

market_state.market_state_score: liquidity axis averages `components.spread` values from broker_intel_scores WITHOUT any freshness filter (no date bound on find()) — a very stale broker score can dominate the composite forever. Add a max-age filter (e.g. at>=now-24h) or use a rolling window.
ops_routes.release_safety: opens /app/docs/TEST_MANIFEST.md with hard-coded absolute path — will fail in any deploy layout where /app is different. Consider os.path.join(BASE_DIR, 'docs', ...).

ops_routes.release_safety: calls release_readiness(request) internally then parses JSONResponse body — this incurs a second full readiness probe on every safety call (Mongo write+read+delete). Consider a helper that returns the dict form so both endpoints share one probe.

posture_routes has a mid-file blank auth: /market-state uses str(user.get('id') or user.get('_id')) but nowhere else in the codebase mixes both — verify get_current_user always sets 'id' (it does, per iter-98 tests). Redundant .get('_id') is harmless dead branch.
